verdict.rationale: The official README documents a 'Non-interactive installation (CI/CD friendly)' path: `npx skills add <repo> --skill <name> -g -a claude-code -y`. Flags select skills, target agents and scope without prompts, and private repos reuse already-configured auth, so an agent can run the install headlessly. Lockfile restore via `skills install` adds a second scriptable path. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the install end to end, explicit documentation of what `-y` suppresses and how the CLI behaves without a TTY.
